name: City Council Special Meeting
agenda_text:
CALL AND NOTICE OF SPECIAL MEETING

To the Members of the City Council of the City of Palos Verdes Estates:

NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that the Mayor has called a special meeting of the City Council to be
conducted through video conference in compliance with the Governor’s and LA County
Health Official’s emergency orders. The meeting will be called to order at 3:00 p.m. on
Tuesday, May 5, 2020. The agenda for the special meeting with the items of business to be transacted
or discussed is set forth below along with instructions on how to attend the public meeting.

Posted by the Office of the City Clerk on Monday, May 4, 2020, at 12:00 p.m.

  May 5, 2020
  3:00 P.M.
  Various teleconference locations

  AGENDA
  OF A SPECIAL MEETING
  OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
  PALOS VERDES ESTATES, CALIFORNIA

Any person having any question concerning any agenda item may call the City Clerk to make
inquiry concerning the item. Upon request, the agenda and, if any, documents in the agenda packet can
be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability in compliance with
the Americans with Disabilities Act. Please contact the City Clerk at 310-378-0383, at least 8 hours
prior to the meeting to request a disability-related modification or accommodation.

The City Council welcomes and encourages public participation at the Council meetings. This meeting
will be held via videoconference only in order to reduce the risk of spreading COVID-19 and pursuant
to the Governor’s Executive Orders N-25-20 and N-29-20 and the County of Los Angeles Public Health
Officer’s Safer at Home Order (revised March 21, 2020). All votes taken during this teleconference
meeting will be by roll call vote, and the vote will be publicly reported.

HOW TO VIEW THE MEETING: No physical location from which members of the public may
observe the meeting and offer public comment will be provided. You may attend the meeting through
a computer or telephone:
   BY COMPUTER:
  https://us02web.zoom.us/j/82518647902

  Zoom Meeting ID: 825-1864-7902 or

  BY TELEPHONE: 1 669 900 9128, Enter Code 82518647902#

HOW TO PARTICIPATE BEFORE THE MEETING: Members of the public are encouraged to
submit email correspondence to CityCouncilMeeting@pvestates.org before the meeting begins. The
email will be distributed to all councilmembers. Any public comments on the agenda item sent before
3:30 pm on May 1 to this email a d d r e s s will be read aloud ( f o r u p t o t h r e e m i n u t e s )

HOW TO PARTICIPATE DURING THE MEETING: Members of the public may also speak during
the meeting through the Zoom application. You must first sign up to speak before the item you would
like to speak on has been called by the Mayor and then you must be present in the Zoom conference to
be recognized.

  CALL TO ORDER

  ROLL CALL

  APPROVAL OF AGENDA

  PUBLIC COMMENT ON CLOSED SESSION ITEM

  CLOSED SESSION
  This time has been set aside for the City Council to meet in a closed session to discuss the
  matters listed below pursuant to Government Codes §§ 54957 54957.6. The Mayor or City
  Attorney will give an additional oral report regarding the closed session.

  1.  PUBLIC EMPLOYMENT
  Pursuant to Government Code §54957
  Title: City Manager

  2.  CONFERENCE WITH LABOR NEGOTIATOR
  Pursuant to Government Code §54957.6
  City Representative: City Attorney
  Unrepresented Employee: City Manager

  RECONVENE TO OPEN SESSION

  CLOSED SESSION ANNOUNCEMENT
  At the conclusion of the closed session, the Council may continue any item listed on the closed
  session agenda to the open session agenda for discussion or to take formal action as it may
  deem appropriate.

  ADJOURNMENT
 I hereby certify under penalty of perjury under the laws of the State of California, that the foregoing
agenda was posted on the City Hall Bulletin Boards located by front door and inside adjacent to
Council Chambers located at 340 Palos Verdes Drive West, Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274, Palos
Verdes Golf Club, and Malaga Cove Library and posted on the City’s website (pvestates.org)
not less than 24 hours prior to the meeting in accordance with Government Code Section
54954.2. Dated this 4th day of May, 2020.
  K i B l A i Ci

ACTION MINUTES
  OF THE MAY 5, 2020 SPECIAL CLOSED SESSION
  MEETING OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
  PALOS VERDES ESTATES, CALIFORNIA

CALL TO ORDER

A Special teleconference meeting of the Palos Verdes Estates City Council via Zoom pursuant to
Executive Order N25-20 issued by Governor Gavin Newsom on March 12, 2020, was called to order
by Mayor McGowan at 3:01 P.M., notice having been given with affidavit thereto on file.
Members of the public were provided with the following information to provide public input:

Join Zoom Meeting:
https://us02web.zoom.us/j/82518647902
Meeting ID: 825 1864 7902 or
via phone call: (669) 900-9128 Code: 825 1864 7902#

ROLL CALL

PRESENT:  Mayor McGowan, Mayor Pro Tem Kemps, Councilmembers Davidson,
  Kao, Lozzi

ALSO PRESENT:  City Attorney Hogin

APPROVAL OF AGENDA

ACTION:  Moved by Mayor McGowan, and second by Mayor Pro Tem Kemps to approve the
agenda as presented. Motion carried (5-0)

PUBLIC COMMENT ON CLOSED SESSION ITEM(S) - None

The City Council recessed to Closed Session at 3:03 PM. to discuss the matters listed below
pursuant to Government Codes § 54957, § 54957.6. The Mayor or City Attorney will give an
additional oral report regarding the closed session.

CITY COUNCIL SPECIAL MEETING - MINUTES
May 5, 2020
   1.  PUBLIC EMPLOYEE
  APPOINTMENT Pursuant to
  Government Code §54957 Title: City
  Manager

  2.  CONFERENCE WITH LABOR NEGOTIATOR
  Pursuant to Government Code §54957.6
  City Representative: City Attorney
  Unrepresented Employee: City Manager

RECONVENE TO OPEN SESSION

The City Council reconvened to open session at 3:57 P.M. All Councilmembers were present.

CLOSED SESSION ANNOUNCEMENT

City Attorney Hogin announced that the City Council met in closed session and discussed the
items listed on the posted agenda, and that the Council has taken no reportable actions.

There being No further business to come before the City Council, the Mayor adjourned the meeting
at 3:58 pm.

RESPECTFULLY SUBMITTED,

  /s/
___________________________________
Carol Cowley, Interim City Clerk

  APPROVED:

  /s/
  ___________________________________
  David A. McGowan, Mayor
